map.：RFC 6844 定义，用于降低证书被错误签发的风险。: : defined by RFC 6844, it reduces the risk of mistakenly issued certificates.
map.：查询沿 CNAME 链向上回溯；若域名及其父级均无 CAA 记录，则任何 CA: : lookups walk up the CNAME chain; if neither the domain nor any parent has a CAA record, any CA may issue.
map.💡 CAA（Certification Authority Authorizat: 💡 CAA (Certification Authority Authorization) restricts which CAs may issue certificates for your domain. Once added, certificate authorities will check this record.
map.限制哪些 CA 可签发本域证书，防误签发。: Restrict which CAs may issue certificates for the domain, guarding against mis-issuance.
map.证书签发前自检：上线前生成一条 issue 记录限定只允许自家 CA，配合 is: Pre-issuance self-check: before going live, create an issue record limiting issuance to your own CA and pair it with issuewild to constrain wildcard certificates, reducing the risk of a subdomain being fraudulently certified.
`example.com. CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org"` allows only Let's Encrypt to issue.
map.不影响已签发，仅约束未来签发。: No. It constrains only future issuance, not certificates already issued.
map.CAA 记录会阻断所有证书签发吗？: Does a CAA record block all certificate issuance?
map.只阻断未被授权的 CA。CAA 是「白名单」而非黑名单：没有记录时任何 CA 都: Only unauthorized CAs are blocked. CAA is a whitelist, not a blacklist: with no record any CA may issue, but once an issue record exists only the listed CAs can. For issuance monitoring, add an iodef record so CAs report attempted violations to a mailbox or URL you specify.
